newsitem.title: USA: American Residential closes six purchases.
newsitem.headline: American Residential closes six purchases.

text.p: American Residential Services Inc said Tuesday it closed six acquisitions totalling about $19 million in historical annualized revenues.
The company, which provides residential heating, air conditioning, plumbing, electrical and appliance services, said the deals were the first round of acquisitions for the quarter.
The companies acquired included Southcoast Heating & Air Conditioning in San Diego, Allied Plumbing in Los Angeles and Larry Teague and Sons Plumbing Inc in Jacksonville, Florida, it said.
American Residential also said it had closed an agreement with a new bank syndicate led by NationsBank Corp to increase its credit facility from $55 million to $100 million.
It said it planned to use the facility together with issuances of its common stock to fund future acquisitions.
